subject: An immense, dim Pandoran forest canopy seen from very high above, the branching limbs and root-like waterways spreading into a faint tree-like fractal pattern across the whole land, everything dissolving into deep atmospheric haze toward the edges; no single creature or focal point, only the suggestion of endless branching structure under a dark sky.
scene: A planetary-scale vista at deep dusk, low contrast, detail swallowed by distance and haze.
camera: An ultra-wide, very high vantage panoramic view, looking down and out across an immense branching landscape, no foreground subject.
light: Dim, diffuse bioluminescent ambience from far below, deep indigo and teal, very low contrast, no bright focal source; mood not subject.
palette: Predominantly dark void-indigo and deep teal-indigo, the faintest cyan glimmer in the far branching pattern, kept dark for overlaid text.
style: Painterly atmospheric matte vista, hand-painted, soft and immersive - a mood backdrop, not a figure to study.
detail_level: Deliberately low and dissolving; detail only hinted, most of the frame dim haze so text reads cleanly over it.
composition: Ultra-wide horizon-less expanse, branching structure spread across the lower and middle frame, vast dark sky above, everything low-contrast with no bright focal subject.
consistency_notes: Same dark, hazy, low-contrast Pandora-establishing mood as the other chapter backgrounds; very dark so overlaid long-form text stays readable. A branching motif echoes the chapter's tree-of-life theme without becoming a figure.
